data.name: Mobeen
data.gender_notes: Mobeen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is present or exists. The name Mobeen carries the meaning “Present, Existent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Mobeen usually hope their child will grow to embody present, existent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are always present and aware of Allah
data.etymology: Mobeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Present, Existent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mobeen total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مبين
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبين هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'بين' الذي يعني الوضوح والظهور. في القرآن الكريم، يوصف الله بأنه مبين ومفسر للآيات والعلامات. اسم مبين يعني الشخص الذي يوضح ويفسر الأمور ويجعلها واضحة للآخرين. هذا الاسم يحمل دلالة روحية عميقة، حيث يشير إلى القدرة على الإيمان والتفكير الواضح.

in_urdu.name: مبین
in_urdu.meaning: وضاحت کرنے والا، ظاہر کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبین نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'بین' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے واضح کرنا یا ظاہر کرنا۔ یہ نام اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو امور کو واضح کرتا ہے اور دوسروں کے لئے بات کو سمجھنے میں آسان بناتا ہے۔ مبین نام اسلامی تقویم میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی صفت کے طور پر قرآن میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मोबीन
in_hindi.meaning: स्पष्ट करने वाला, जाहिर करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोबीन नाम का अर्थ है स्पष्टता और सच्चाई को प्रकट करना। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो दूसरों को सही रास्ता दिखाते हैं और उन्हें समझने में मदद करते हैं। इस्लामी परंपरा में, मोबीन नाम का व्यक्ति उच्च नैतिक मूल्यों और आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान के साथ जुड़ा होता है।

in_english.name: Mobeen
in_english.meaning: One who clarifies, makes clear, or explains
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mobeen is derived from the Arabic root 'بین', which means to clarify or make clear. In Islamic tradition, Mobeen is an attribute of Allah, signifying the one who makes things clear and understandable. The name implies a person of spiritual insight, clarity of thought, and the ability to guide others. Historically, the term is referenced in the Quran as a divine attribute, emphasizing the importance of understanding and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mobeen holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic communities as it denotes the concept of presence and existence in various aspects of life. This name is often given to children as a reminder of God's presence and the importance of being present in the moment. It also stresses the idea of being steadfast and reliable, qualities that are valued in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mobeen signifies the belief that God is always present and aware of every action and thought. It serves as a reminder of the importance of living a life in submission to God and striving to be a good servant and obedient creant in His sight. The name also carries the meaning of being steadfast and persevering in faith, a crucial quality in the spiritual journey towards closer relationship with God.
